items.stimulus: A regional seismic network has 4,000 monitoring stations. Technicians chose a random sample of 80 of these stations to inspect. Of the stations inspected, 6 showed calibration drift in their ground-motion sensors.
items.stem: Which of the following is the best estimate of the number of stations in the network that show calibration drift?
